# The Living Room Vet

Website: https://thelivingroom.vet
Location: 2619 Spruce Street, Boulder, CO, 80302
Service status: Housecalls: targeting late 2027 · Clinic: targeting early 2027. Target dates are estimates; contact the practice for current availability.
Phone: (720) 764-6677
Email: admin@thelivingroom.vet
Planned hours (America/Denver): Monday–Saturday, 9 am–5 pm Mountain Time
Contact: https://thelivingroom.vet/contact#contact-form

Emergency guidance: If you can’t reach us, contact your nearest local 24-hour emergency veterinary service.
Website inquiries request follow-up and are not confirmed appointments. The contact form is not monitored for emergencies.
